offers.rationale: Practice sessions are a volume purchase. A 5-pack commitment should carry a modest incentive. Members who practice regularly upgrade to coaching.
offers.why_now: Practice sessions have highest engagement volume — convert frequent users to committed pack buyers
offers.risk_note: Volume-based discount. No "sale" framing. Natural commitment ladder.

offers.bundle: Full Bag Fitting + Loft & Lie (usually R2,600)
offers.rationale: Full bag fitting is a high-ticket, high-commitment decision. Offering a combined assessment as a single day experience reduces friction for serious golfers.
offers.why_now: Club fitting page has high intent traffic — combine into a day experience to capture now
offers.risk_note: Medium risk — only activate if fitting page traffic is confirmed high. Monitor for profit impact.

offers.saving: R200 — and you get the lesson free if you upgrade to 3-lesson package
offers.rationale: Coaching should never look cheap. This offer adds the lesson free if they upgrade — creates an upgrade incentive rather than discounting the core product.
offers.why_now: Serious leads interested in coaching — reduce assessment-to-lesson conversion friction
offers.risk_note: Value-add framing, not discount framing. Doesn't undercut coaching credibility.
